posts.title: The Handshake
posts.description: A handshake is a strange way to introduce two people. Each offers an empty hand, and for a moment the introduction is something neither person can do alone. posts.title: The Rest of the Page
posts.description: Imagine opening a book to its first page and making a chart of every word you find there. The chart is accurate. The book is not. I came across a small piece of software today that reminded me how easily we can confuse those two things. posts.title: The Number on the Windowsill
posts.description: A thermometer on a windowsill tells you one thing about the morning. It does not tell you whether the pavement is slippery, whether your neighbor needs a hand carrying groceries, or whether you ought to take an umbrella.
